# strided-rs v0.8.0

`strided-exec` is replaced by [`threadteam` 0.1](https://github.com/tensor4all/threadteam-rs),
the same crate (same API, history preserved) moved to its own repository so the other
tensor4all CPU crates can share one placement implementation. `strided-exec` is no longer
part of this workspace and gets no further releases.

Released at 0.8.0: `strided-perm`, `strided-basic`, `strided-fused`, `strided-kernel`,
`strided-nn`. `strided-traits` and `strided-view` stay at 0.7.0 (they never depended on
`strided-exec`).

**Migration.** Replace `strided_exec::` with `threadteam::` (`Exec`, `Pool`,
`PoolBuilder` and everything else keep their names and signatures), or use the
re-exports of `strided-basic` (`strided_basic::{Exec, Pool, PoolBuilder}`). In
`Cargo.toml`, replace `strided-exec` with:

```toml
threadteam = "0.1.0"
```

with the same features (`parallel`, and `ledger` for tests).

The `parallel` features of `strided-perm`, `strided-basic`, `strided-fused` and
`strided-kernel` forward to `threadteam/parallel` as they did to `strided-exec/parallel`.
